title: Rental Cleaning Pricing Calculator
description: Enter the bedrooms, beds, extras and the checkout-to-check-in window. See the price, the crew you need, the finish time and your profit. Send owners a polished quote with your own logo. title: Cleaning Budget & Quote Planner
description: Price every cleaning job from your real numbers: wages, payroll taxes, workers' comp, supplies, equipment, travel and your share of overhead. Plan your monthly budget. Works offline in your browser on Windows and Mac, with a full installation and use guide. Pay once, no subscription. Single-use license for one business.

title: CleanReach
description: Find local businesses that may need cleaning, like offices, restaurants, salons, gyms, medical offices and hotels, from published map listings. Keep them in one private notebook. Phone and tablet version you host yourself. Optional Sync through your own free Supabase account. Searches use your own Geoapify key. Pay once, no subscription. Single-use license for one business.

title: PlazaRoute
description: For cleaning businesses with weekly customers, like restroom cleaning for restaurants, salons, gyms and offices. Monthly accounts, a weekly visit log and a route day planned plaza by plaza. Sends each day's stops to your cleaners' phones, with before-and-after photos and Job complete. Your own booking link and QR code: customers book one-time jobs or ask for monthly service. Customers pay on your own Stripe or PayPal link. Revenue by month and week, and a pricing and profit check before you quote. Finds new businesses near you and plans plaza days (everything CleanReach does). Runs on Mac (macOS 13.5 or newer), Windows, and a phone and tablet version you host yourself. Sync, your team and bookings use your own free Supabase account. Pay once, no subscription. Single-use license for one business.
